pr_title: Add a flag to expose undeclared test outputs in unzipped form.

issue_context.title: option to not zip test results
issue_context.body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

Bazel should allow test results to be left as is as opposed to putting them into a zip file.

### Feature requests: what underlying problem are you trying to solve with this feature?

I would like to make it easier to browse test output which is an interlinked set of HTML files directly from Buildbarn Browser without having to download and extract the zip file and then open the index page in the browser.

### Any other information, logs, or outputs that you want to share?

Initially raised to buildbarn browser: https://github.com/buildbarn/bb-browser/issues/35 where they suggested this should be fixed in Bazel instead.

review_comments: FYI, we usually start with `experimental_` for a new feature flag and set its default value to `false` if it is a boolean value. But in this case, calling `zip_undeclared_test_outputs` and defaulting to `true` make more sense.
Not sure whether internal code relies on this name. Please keep an eye on the internal usages and tests when importing.

Thanks for the heads up. The preexisting constant must stay. I've also made changes to handle the zipped/unzipped cases differently, as some internal code relies on the zip file (not the directory) being a spawn output.
